title: The scale of life, on a logarithmic axis
caption: Each step up the axis is ten times larger. A large protein (about 10 nm) and a virus (about 100 nm) are below the 0.2 µm limit of a light microscope; bacteria (1–5 µm) and eukaryotic cells (10–100 µm) can be seen with one.
alt: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale in micrometres: protein 0.01, virus 0.1, bacterium 2, red blood cell 8, plant cell 60, human egg 120.
description: A large protein such as an antibody, about 0.01 µm (10 nm).
Human egg cell, about 120 µm, just visible to the eye.
